profile.name: 通用USB设备
profile.description: 通过USB总线连接的通用设备或实验仪器接口对象，可执行控制传输、批量传输和中断传输，并管理端点、接口、配置与描述符读取。适合用于与各类USB连接的实验室设备进行底层通信和枚举。
profile.description_en: A generic USB-connected device or laboratory instrument interface that supports control, bulk, and interrupt transfers, along with endpoint, interface, configuration, and descriptor management. It is suitable for low-level communication and enumeration of various USB-connected lab devices.
